question: As of 31 July 2026, what had Grasim Industries Limited (NSE: GRASIM) said about its capacity expansion timeline by that date?
answer: As of 31 July 2026, the most recent Grasim communication in data (Q4FY26 investor deck, known 20 May 2026) outlined FY26 standalone capex of ₹2,263 Cr with capacity expansion items: Cellulosic Fibres capacity expansion (including debottlenecking) ₹424 Cr planned (₹397 Cr spent), Chemicals capacity expansion — Caustic Soda 1,505→1,530 KTPA (₹10 Cr planned) and Chlorine Derivatives 1,058→1,137 KTPA (₹158 Cr planned), Specialty Chemicals Epoxy Polymers 246 KTPA (₹18 Cr planned), and Birla Opus decorative paints ₹643 Cr planned (₹550 Cr spent). No newer post-Q4FY26 capacity-expansion timeline statement exists in the held data.
working: Q4FY26 deck (known 2026-05-20) p39 standalone capex plan; Q2FY26 deck showed Caustic Soda 1,505→1,530 KTPA and Chlorine Derivatives 1,058→1,137 KTPA; Q1FY26 deck showed Chlorine Derivatives 1,047→1,126 KTPA. Nov 2024 concall claims include grey cement 162.4 MTPA by FY25 and Kharagpur plant Q4FY25.
missing: not in data: any capacity-expansion timeline statement dated after 20 May 2026 (Q4FY26 deck) up to 31 Jul 2026; no later concall/deck/AR in store.

rows.horizon: expected to be completed in the next 6 m
rows.quote: The amalgamation scheme now awaits approval from NCLT Ahmedabad and is expected to be completed in the next 6 months.

the Board has approved additional capex for current financial year of ₹138 crores, of which ₹118 crores is for the capacity increase at pulp plant at Harihar and ₹20 crores is for normal modernization at textile plants.
And of course, this does not include the Kesoram and India Cement capacity as the acquisition process is underway, awaiting regulatory approvals.

The company has added grey cement capacity of 9.9 million tons till October '24 in the current financial year and plans to further add 6.3 million tons, taking the total grey cement capacity to 162.4 million tons per annum by FY '25.

The utilization levels are ramping up month-on-month at three plants commissioned in Q1, namely Ludhiana, Panipat and Cheyyar. We have also started trial runs at 2 more plants at Chamarajanagar in Karnataka and Mahad in Maharashtra.
Our sixth plant at Kharagpur in West Bengal is expected to go live in Q4 FY '25.

rows.horizon: ech project commissioning in the next fi
rows.quote: we are already running an ECH project, which will get commissioned in the next financial year. So that makes us more or less 80% integrated already as far as the ECH is concerned.
With the projects under implementation, renewable capacity is expected to reach 2 gigawatts in the current financial year.
